# SEC-007: No world writable folders under the platform data root

- **Group:** Secrets on disk
- **Severity when it fails:** high
- **Root:** the full result needs `sudo`. Without root this check may report `unknown`; it never reports a pass it could not verify.

## Why it matters

The platform data root holds compose files, proxy config and app sources that run as root or inside containers. A world writable folder there lets any local user plant config or code that the platform then deploys.

## Verify by hand

```sh
find /data/coolify /etc/dokploy -maxdepth 5 -type d -perm -0002 -ls
```

## How to fix it

chmod o-w the folders.

## What a fix can break

An app that writes there as an unrelated user needs a dedicated owner instead.
